ug_programmes.name: B.A. (Bachelor of Arts)
ug_programmes.eligibility: Passed 12th Std (H.S.C.) examination conducted by Maharashtra State Board or any equivalent examination recognized by University of Mumbai.
ug_programmes.description: Comprehensive humanities programme offering deep foundations in History, Economics, English Literature, Geography, Psychology, and Indian Knowledge Systems.

ug_programmes.name: B.A. : Film, TV & New Media Production
ug_programmes.eligibility: Passed 12th Std (H.S.C.) in any stream (Arts/Commerce/Science) from Maharashtra State Board or equivalent.
ug_programmes.description: Creative professional degree covering scriptwriting, cinematography, editing, TV production, and digital media dynamics.

ug_programmes.name: B.A. : Multimedia & Mass Communication (BAMMC)
ug_programmes.eligibility: Passed 12th Std (H.S.C.) in any stream with minimum passing percentage as per University of Mumbai.
ug_programmes.description: Prepares students for dynamic careers in journalism, advertising, public relations, mass communication, and media production.

ug_programmes.name: B.Com. (Bachelor of Commerce)
ug_programmes.eligibility: Passed 12th Std (H.S.C.) Commerce or equivalent examination.
ug_programmes.description: Flagship commerce degree covering financial management, auditing, taxation, marketing, business law, and modern accountancy practices.

ug_programmes.name: B.Com. : Banking & Insurance
ug_programmes.eligibility: Passed 12th Std (H.S.C.) Commerce / Science / Arts with required aggregate as per University guidelines.
ug_programmes.description: Specialized degree focusing on modern banking systems, risk assessment, life & general insurance, and financial regulations.

ug_programmes.name: B.Com. : Transport Management
ug_programmes.eligibility: Passed 12th Std (H.S.C.) examination in any stream.
ug_programmes.description: Niche programme equipping students with operational and administrative skills for multimodal transportation and global supply chain networks.

ug_programmes.name: B.Com. : Financial Management
ug_programmes.description: Deep focus on capital markets, portfolio management, financial statement analysis, and managerial economics.

ug_programmes.name: B.Com. : Accounting & Finance (B.A.F.)
ug_programmes.eligibility: Passed 12th Std (H.S.C.) Commerce or equivalent with required minimum marks.
ug_programmes.description: Intensive professional training in auditing, advanced financial accounting, direct/indirect taxation, and corporate governance.

ug_programmes.name: B.M.S. (Bachelor of Management Studies)
ug_programmes.eligibility: Passed 12th Std (H.S.C.) in any discipline with minimum required aggregate marks.
ug_programmes.description: Premium management programme building leadership, strategic decision-making, organizational behaviour, and specialized domain expertise.

ug_programmes.name: B.Sc. (Bachelor of Science - General)
ug_programmes.eligibility: Passed 12th Std (H.S.C.) Science stream with Chemistry, Biology / Mathematics as required.
ug_programmes.description: Pure sciences degree with well-equipped laboratory training in Botany, Zoology, Physics, and Inorganic/Organic Chemistry.

ug_programmes.name: B.Sc. : Computer Science (B.Sc. CS)
ug_programmes.eligibility: Passed 12th Std (H.S.C.) Science examination with Mathematics as one of the subjects from Maharashtra State Board or equivalent.
ug_programmes.description: Comprehensive technical computing degree covering open source technologies, web development, cyber and digital safety, system programming, algorithms, and applied software engineering.

ug_programmes.name: B.Sc. : Information Technology (B.Sc. IT)
ug_programmes.eligibility: Passed 12th Std (H.S.C.) examination with Mathematics as a mandatory subject, securing minimum passing marks as per University rules.
ug_programmes.description: Industry-aligned IT degree covering computer fundamentals, Google Workspace, PHP and .NET Core, Web Design, Data Analytics with Excel, Data Science, and Modern Networking.

pg_programmes.name: M.A. : History
pg_programmes.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree (B.A.) in History or related Humanities from a recognized university.
pg_programmes.description: Advanced postgraduate study in historical historiography, Maratha socio-economic history, Indian Constitution, and emancipatory modern world movements.

pg_programmes.name: M.Com. : Advanced Accountancy
pg_programmes.eligibility: B.Com, B.A.F., B.B.I., or equivalent commerce undergraduate degree from a recognized university.
pg_programmes.description: Postgraduate specialization covering advanced auditing, wealth management, corporate financial accounting, and operations research.

pg_programmes.name: M.Sc. : Information Technology (M.Sc. IT)
pg_programmes.eligibility: B.Sc. IT / B.Sc. CS / B.C.A. / B.Sc. Mathematics/Statistics with required minimum percentage.
pg_programmes.description: Advanced master's degree exploring cutting-edge computing paradigms: Data Science, Soft Computing, Image Processing, Modern Networking, Microservices, Deep Learning, and Cyber Forensics.

pg_programmes.name: M.Sc. : Organic Chemistry
pg_programmes.eligibility: B.Sc. with Chemistry as principal subject from a recognized university.
pg_programmes.description: Rigorous postgraduate degree with advanced chemical laboratories, analytical research projects, and industrial field training.

aicte_programmes.name: Bachelor of Computer Applications (B.C.A.)
aicte_programmes.eligibility: Passed 12th Std (H.S.C.) in any stream with Mathematics/Statistics or equivalent as per AICTE and University norms.
aicte_programmes.description: AICTE-approved computer applications degree emphasizing practical software engineering, Java, C++, Python, Unix, Oracle, Algorithms, Cloud Computing, and Mobile UI/UX.

aicte_programmes.name: Bachelor of Business Administration (B.B.A.)
aicte_programmes.eligibility: Passed 12th Std (H.S.C.) in any stream with minimum passing aggregate as prescribed by AICTE / University.
aicte_programmes.description: AICTE-approved business administration curriculum focusing on entrepreneurship, startup ecosystems, operations management, corporate governance, and design thinking.

aicte_programmes.name: Bachelor of Management Studies (B.M.S. - AICTE)
aicte_programmes.eligibility: Passed 12th Std (H.S.C.) in Arts, Science, or Commerce stream.
aicte_programmes.description: AICTE-aligned managerial leadership programme covering strategic management, logistics, and organizational excellence.
